fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Original birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to determine natal Moon longitude for the lunar return calculation.

fields.name: birthTime
fields.description: Original birth time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Determines exact natal Moon position for monthly return timing.

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Approximate date near the desired lunar return (YYYY-MM-DD). The Moon returns to its natal position every ~27.3 days, so provide a date within a few days of the expected return.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the lunar return location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Affects the Ascendant and house cusps of the return chart.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the lunar return location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Determines local sidereal time for house calculations.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Decimal hours from UTC OR IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York"). IANA resolved to the DST-correct offset for the birthDate. Output datetime is adjusted to this timezone.

fields.name: houseSystem
fields.description: House system for the lunar return chart. Placidus (default), Whole Sign, Equal, or Koch.
